names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 1 martie, «Sfânta Cuvioasă Muceniță Evdochia».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Μαρτίου, «Αγία Ευδοκία η από Σαμαρειτών η Οσιομάρτυς», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 1. март ст. ст., „Преподобномученица Евдокија.“, with the rank word Преподобномученица left off. The heading gives no epithet; Heliopolis, which the folder's English name carries, is in the body's first sentence.

floruit.note: The Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 1 March: „Живела у Илиопољу граду Феничанском за време царовања Трајанова.“ It states the reign of Trajan and no year, so the interval is that reign's own dates, 98 to 117. The folder carried no dates at all before this reading. The entry also has her live fifty-six years in the monastery, which the reign alone cannot hold, so this is a floruit and not a life.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 1 martie — «Sfânta Cuvioasă Muceniță Evdochia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Μαρτίου — «Αγία Ευδοκία η από Σαμαρειτών η Οσιομάρτυς»

attestations.note: The page heads her «Αγια Ευδοκια η Απο Σαμαρειτων η Οσιομαρτυς (; - 107)» and puts her birth «στη Ηλιούπολη της επαρχίας Λιβανησίας, της Φοινίκης, την εποχή του Τραϊανού (98 - 117 μ.Χ.)». It names the monk Germanus whose counsels brought her to repentance, the bishop Theodotus who baptised her after a vision, Aurelian before whom she was first tried, the governor Diogenes who released her, and Vincentius who beheaded her. It lists portions of her relics at the monasteries of Simonopetra on the Holy Mountain, Phaneromeni on Salamis, Agia Lavra of Kalavryta and Voulkanou in Messenia, and at the Lavra of St Alexander Nevsky in St Petersburg. Its «(; - 107)» is a death year the corpus's own dates, read off doxologia's reign of Trajan, do not carry; the corpus's reading is left as it stands and saint.gr's is recorded here.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 14.03.2026 (1. март ст. ст.) — „Преподобномученица Евдокија.“

hymns.text: Mieluşeaua Ta, Iisuse, Evdochia, strigă cu glas mare: pe Tine, Mirele meu, te iubesc și pe Tine căutându-Te mă chinuiesc și împreună mă răstignesc și împreună mă îngrop cu Botezul Tău; și pătimesc pentru Tine, ca să împărățesc întru Tine; și mor pentru tine, ca să viez pentru Tine; ci, ca o jertfă fără de prihană, primește-mă pe mine ceea ce cu dragoste mă jertfesc Ție. Pentru rugăciunile ei, ca un milostiv, mântuiește sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfintei Cuvioase Mucenițe Evdochia

english.text: Thy ewe-lamb, O Jesus, Eudocia, cries out with a loud voice: Thee, my Bridegroom, do I love, and seeking Thee I am in torment; with Thee I am crucified and with Thee buried in Thy baptism; I suffer for Thy sake that I may reign in Thee, and I die for Thee that I may live for Thee. Receive me, then, as an offering without blemish, sacrificed to Thee in love. At her prayers, since Thou art merciful, save Thou our souls.

hymns.text: Φόβον ἔνθεον, ἀναλαβοῦσα, κόσμου ἔλιπες, τὴν εὐδοξίαν, καὶ τῷ Λόγῳ Εὐδοκία προέδραμες, οὐ τὸν ζυγὸν τὴ σαρκί σου βαστάσασα, ὑπερφυῶς ἠγωνίσω δι' αἵματος. Μάρτυς ἔνδοξε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως, on the page of Αγία Ευδοκία η από Σαμαρειτών η Οσιομάρτυς. It names her and turns on the name, εὐδοξία against Εὐδοκία. The page prints two other texts under her as well: an «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον» in Ἦχος πλ. δ’, «Ἐν σοί Μῆτερ ἀκριβῶς διεσώθη τό κατ᾽ εἰκόνα», which is the common of a venerable woman with her name set into its last line, and a Κάθισμα in Ἦχος πλ. δ’ which the corpus's schema has no kind for. The first apolytikion and the kontakion are the two taken here.

english.text: Taking up a godly fear, thou didst leave behind the world's good repute, and didst run forward to the Word, O Eudocia, not bearing the yoke upon thy flesh; beyond nature thou didst contend through blood. Glorious martyr, entreat Christ our God, that he grant us his great mercy.

hymns.text: Ὁ εὐδοκήσας ἐκ βυθοῦ ἀπωλείας, πρός εὐσεβείας τόν ἀκρότατον ὅρον, ἀναγαγεῖν σε ἔνδοξε ὡς λίθον ἐκλεκτόν, οὗτος καί τόν βίον σου, τῇ ἀθλήσει λαμπρύνας, χάριν ἰαμάτων σοι, Εὐδοκία παρέχει· ὃν ἐκδυσώπει σῴζεσθαι ἡμᾶς, Ὁσιομάρτυς, Ἀγγέλων ἐφάμιλλε.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθείς, on the page of Αγία Ευδοκία η από Σαμαρειτών η Οσιομάρτυς. It names her and plays εὐδοκήσας against Εὐδοκία as the apolytikion plays on εὐδοξία.

english.text: He who was well pleased to lead thee up, O glorious one, out of the depth of ruin to the utmost bound of godliness, as a chosen stone, hath made thy life shine by thy contest and granteth thee the grace of healings, O Eudocia. Beseech him that we be saved, O venerable martyr, rival of the angels.
